'''Toob Ancher''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Saadoon-Kauldi]]. He was the brother of [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]].

==Biography==
Toob spent most of his time in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]]. One day, a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] that was planted by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] exploded in his face. His face was horribly disfigured, with his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] completely blown out and his right eye had to be replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthesis. Shortly afterward, he contracted ''Brekken Vinthern'', more commonly known as the [[Bitter Winter]] disease, and he began to go insane. He was taken to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Redcap]] by [[Drake Paulsen]] to search out [[Saylor Marjan]] and to recover a debt owed to [[Saadoon-Kauldi]]. While on Redcap, Toob completely lost his mind and went insane. He set out to attack the ''[[Aremin]]'', believing he could escape on his own ship. Drake Paulsen was forced to shoot him out of the sky to prevent Imperials from shooting him down.
